newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Thursday set a one-day repo tender to add market liquidity of a fixed volume of one billion crowns.
Minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.

The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the local money market through a one-week repo tender on Wednesday, with average yield rising to 17.62 percent from 17.00 percent in a similar operation on Tuesday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 9 lacked some 0.89 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 15.
